title: Single-File Packaging and Distribution
description: Configure .NET 8 self-contained single-file publish. Add DPI awareness manifest. Ensure PDFium native DLL bundles correctly. Produce portable exe for Win10+ x64.
action: Add publish profile for self-contained single-file x64. Add app.manifest with DPI awareness (PerMonitorV2) and Windows 10 compatibility. Configure .csproj with PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, RuntimeIdentifier=win-x64, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true. Test publish output runs on clean machine.

criteria: Published output contains single PdfTeachAnnotator.exe file
convergence.verification: dotnet publish src/PdfTeachAnnotator -c Release -o publish/ && ls publish/*.exe
convergence.definition_of_done: Single PdfTeachAnnotator.exe in publish/ folder, runs on clean Win10 x64 machine without .NET runtime installed

files.change: Add PropertyGroup: PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, RuntimeIdentifier=win-x64, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true, PublishTrimmed=false
DPI awareness PerMonitorV2, Windows 10/11 supportedOS GUIDs, requestedExecutionLevel=asInvoker

implementation: Create app.manifest with: dpiAwareness=PerMonitorV2, supportedOS IDs for Win10 ({8e0f7a12-bfb3-4fe8-b9a5-48fd50a15a9a}) and Win11, requestedExecutionLevel=asInvoker
Verify single exe output and approximate size (target < 50MB)

commands: dotnet publish src/PdfTeachAnnotator -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o publish/
integration: Run published exe on machine without .NET runtime
Verify DPI scaling on high-DPI display
Verify PDF rendering works from single exe

rationale.chosen_approach: Self-contained single-file publish bundles .NET runtime + native DLLs into one exe. IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract ensures PDFium DLL is included.
decision_factors: No runtime dependency on target machine
Single file for easy USB distribution
rationale.tradeoffs: Larger exe size (~40-50MB) due to bundled runtime, but meets portability requirement

risks: Antivirus may flag unsigned single-file .NET apps
PDFium native DLL extraction on first run may be slow
